experimental_method: Static equilibrium cell (titanium vessel, 500 mL synthetic formation water + excess CH4, 16 h stirring + 1 h settling at set T and P); the saturated solution is transferred to a gas collector, depressurised at high temperature, and the evolved CH4 volume is determined by gas chromatography (FID, TCD check) against a known volume of reference gas.
uncertainties_stated: Temperature control +/- 0.1 K. Relative expanded uncertainty of the pressure pump about 1 % (k = 2) and of the GC measurement about 14 % (k = 2); relative expanded uncertainty of the final solubility results about 14 % (k = 2).
quality_remarks: Solubility reported only as Sm3 of CH4 per m3 of brine; neither the standard reference state of the gas volume nor the state of the brine volume is defined. Pressures are round nominal values (5-90 MPa). Text says 'a total of 90 experiments were conducted' but Tables 3a-3c hold 70 + 90 + 80 = 240 values; the relation is not explained (90 matches the DF-1 table alone). Reported solubility shows a minimum between 333.15 and 353.15 K at all pressures and then increases with T; the 14 % (k = 2) uncertainty is large. Brine composition is printed as ion contents (Na+ and K+ combined) in g/L; synthetic formation water. A comparison with NaCl solution, NaHCO3 solution and pure water is shown only in Fig. 8b (no table). Data otherwise 'available on request'. No supplementary material is mentioned.
